red.note: AI Red (Stage 5.6, OpenAI). gpt-6-luna is the cheapest current model (D12; id confirmed in the pinned SDK). effort maps to reasoning effort; max_output_tokens 2048 (reasoning tokens count toward it); round_cap is the number of Red slots. These are recorded in match.json red_params; hold them constant within any comparison. The guard caps live in red/red_guard.py.

blue.note: AI Blue (Stage 5.4, Anthropic). Cheapest current-generation model for development (D12). max_output_tokens, request and the structured output format are part of the Blue configuration: hold them constant within any comparison (recorded in match.json blue_params). chunk_size > 1 is refused for scored matches (D4).

analyst.note: Not implemented. Provider unset and caps 0 until the designer sets them; the client refuses to run an agent with no provider.
